scope: Attempt-local fleet supplied in memory to the existing planner; no global registry change or worker dispatch.

program.title: KR1 residual-family census, sequence clues and lossless geometry
program.objective: Prepare a reviewed finite family census and bounded OEIS/primary-source and geometric investigation, preserving the unresolved full KR1 objective and all prior assurance distinctions.
deliverables: Side-specific full-object and residual-root census with exact denominators and distinct/repeated refinements
Exact bounded query log and at most six inspected source records
One lossless 3D representation proposal versus a 2D baseline, or a precise information-loss obstruction
Versioned clue/rule table with at most three frozen variants and all failures retained
Separate scoped critic verdicts and at most three ranked next directions
Fresh resource record and local handoff without a full-KR1 or novelty overclaim
success_criteria: Census counts distinguish full objects, roots, maps, sides and cohort predicates
Search claims record terms, offsets, inspection depth, no-hits and ambiguity
Geometric claims account for all information and have intrinsic reconstruction or an exact obstruction
Each retained new substantive claim has a separate critic verdict with explicit dependencies and assurance
All executed finite inputs and outputs obey the accepted ceiling and budgets
stop_conditions: No renewed execution instruction or a subsequent user stop
Any binding time, computation, memory, storage, query, candidate or dispatch cap
Missing required input, unreliable accounting or an instruction conflict
No intrinsic inverse or coverage argument at the discovery deadline: freeze the gap instead
Scope would require dependencies, providers, external messages, publication or functional repository changes

fleet.description: Three distinct initial research branches, bounded cross-search and geometry follow-up, then a distinct critic and one correction/final-review opportunity.

execution_gates_outside_planner.note: One planner round contains the entire unrolled DAG. The solver checks assignment constraints only; operational resource and authorization gates remain binding.
